macros.doc: The command \specialack provides a generic interface to give special acknowledgement on the title page, such as the one required by ADNI (Section 4.4.7).

macros.name: specialackmark

macros.name: suppressfancybreak
macros.doc: The command \suppressfancybreak allows suppression of the fancy break should it appear at the very bottom of the title page or at the very top of the second page.
